name: rescribe
description: Prompt enhancer: a shortcut rewrites the draft in the prompt box, and a menu shows the change to apply or dismiss.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that rewrites your draft: haiku, sonnet, opus or a full model id.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

autoAccept.title: Auto accept
autoAccept.description: Put the enhanced text in the prompt box right away instead of opening the menu.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the model before giving up.
